description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 18.10.2021 to 24.10.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is for authority purposes only and does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The content focuses on establishing legal compliance requirements for customs payments rather than government structure or personnel matters.
